facts.label: 来源冲突与采用依据
value: Actual main.cpp calls DisplayPort(i2c,480,480), so constructor defaultsCS15/IRQ5 apply and agree with schematic. Unused user_config.h CS5/IRQ15 is not proof of another hardware revision.
Official physical controller isCO5300 although BSP driver class is namedSH8601; transport evidence does not equate the silicon identities.
Panel supply uses DCDC1/VCC3V3 and reset usesALDO3; ALDO2 controls amplifier and is not incorrectly treated as glass power.

Current pinned BSP initialMADCTL30h versus original factory observedA0h is retained. Native snapshot is horizontally mirrored under the explicit BSP-reference presentation policy; glass orientation and touch-to-screen calibration remain unresolved.
C6 structure ZIP internally contains only S3-named2D DXF/PDF, not a C6 solid assembly. Exact C6 dimension photograph supplies exterior geometry.

facts.label: 机械模型的可证明范围

limitations: This model is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD.
Unmeasured depths, corner radii and connector contact geometry are explicit illustrative estimates; no fit, drop-in enclosure or hardware acceptance claim.
Source photographs are unchanged. Any display artwork shown in them is reference only; the live screen receives the simulator framebuffer.
Separate battery is included in the base SKU and omitted in -EN. This shared exterior does not fabricate an internal battery location.

Rear label, connector openings, actuator travel and internal supports remain reference-only because no matching native assembly was found. The visual rear cover is an approximate envelope, not a claim that the product has no ports.
BOOT remains a runtime keyboard/UI control. No imprecisely located exterior actuator is exposed as an exact3D input target.
Official C6-linked archive internally names ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.16-Dxf.dxf/pdf. Those original2D files are retained as evidence and are not relabelled or claimed as a C6 native solid assembly.
